versionControl.title: 5. Version Control
versionControl.description: Save your progress and collaborate securely.
versionControl.content: You have two main ways to use Git: the Command Line (powerful, standard) or GitHub Desktop (easy, visual).
versionControl.cli_desc: The standard command line interface. Essential to learn for long-term career growth.
versionControl.desktop_desc: A visual application that handles Git commands for you. Great for beginners.
